sourceClaims.claim: Min 8, Regular 12, Medium 16, Large 48, and Max 100px are human-verified source labels and values.
Max 100px is the documented pill alias; component circles and exact local radii remain local geometry.
No 9999px approximation is promoted as a foundation token.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: source reconciliation retains the five human-verified labels at 8/12/16/48/100px
evidence.structural-contract: pass: generation emits all five radius variables and the production scan rejects approximate 999/9999px pill radii
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: focused browser assertions resolve Regular to 12px, Max to 100px, and preserve the Select consumer's component-local 20px radius
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: radius values define shape but no standalone accessibility behavior
evidence.focused-visual: pass: exact computed radii distinguish the global named values from component-specific geometry
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: representative surface and field consumers resolve published radii without replacing component-local circle or pill geometry
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: audited radius values do not vary with viewport or content length
